## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, if the runner, a scenario, or the demo store changed.
- [ ] A tool description or schema change has an updated `tools/list` snapshot and `docs/tools.md`.
- [ ] A scenario format change has an updated `docs/scenario-format.md` and a regenerated JSON Schema.
- [ ] A new safety rule or error code has a unit test for each refuse path.
- [ ] No secret, real card number, real customer data, or real host is in the diff.
